notes.title: Foregone Launch & Discount Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]We're in the end game now...[/h2]

Only 3 more days and until we flip the switch and release Foregone. We're especially excited to finally share the game with our Steam Community and can't wait for you to get your hands on it. 

So just when can you start to play...

[h2]Official Launch Schedule[/h2]
Please refer to the exact times for each time zone below.
GMT: 03/01 5:00PM
EST : 03/01 12:00PM
PST : 03/01 9:00AM


[h2]20% Off Launch Discount[/h2]
Foregone will launch at $19.99 and be available at 20% off for the first week after launch. So don’t miss your chance to get it now! 

[h2]Version 1.1 - New Content[/h2]
For the Steam release of Foregone, we wanted to build upon the core experience of Foregone and bring all-new ways to experience the world of Calagan. 

You'll find all of these enhancements on day one in an all-new update.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[h3]New Weapons to Collect and Upgrade[/h3]
[b]The Warscythe[/b]
Sleek and punishing, the Warscythe is a devastating weapon to unleash when surrounded on all sides. Its long reach and swift striking ability make it the perfect addition to player's arsenals who like to charge headfirst into battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34738184/408062c6fa854e67dd3e28620ad5d0541a0c9969.gif[/img]

Inherent Mod: Each hit weakens enemies

[b]Shock Pistol[/b]
Why eliminate one enemy with a single bullet when you can eliminate three? Through the POWER OF SCIENCE, now you can unleash the electric potential of the Shock Pistol and chain together single shots into devastating multi-hits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34738184/b3d76d84636e123a9429704cc59bb0cbc5a6f297.gif[/img]

Inherent Mod: Each shot arcs to nearby enemies

[h3]New Side Missions to Discover and Complete[/h3]
Throughout the world of Calagan you will now encounter hidden distress beacons. Once discovered, you'll be able to access a series of new side missions from a new NPC, The Dispatcher, in the Outpost. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34738184/4928177aeca2c82b1825e6d7eb8512fd0357f82c.png[/img]

There are three different categories of side missions to complete:
[list]
[*] Hazards: Timed challenges which will test your speed and platforming skills as you navigate a twisting environment filled with hazards
[*] Combat: Race to eliminate all targets in the area before time expires
[*] Gauntlet: THe ultimate test of combat and platforming abilities, a true test of an Arbiter's abilities
[/list]

As a reward for completing these side missions, you'll receive a plethora of currency, a shiny new item, and be able to visit the all-new Warsmith.

[h3]New NPC - The Warsmith[/h3]
Upon completing the trials found within the new side missions, you'll encounter the Warsmith. Visit this new NPC armed with your favourite weapon to re-roll one of the perks on the weapon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34738184/f1988db642f1b06185767cb22217bc43f711b3e7.png[/img]

When rerolling weapon perks, you'll be presented with 3 alternate perks to bind with the weapon. Choose wisely as the first re-roll is free of charge as a reward for your challenge completion, but be warned the price for each future roll increases. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34738184/972e997319c7bee129167b3ca5789703cb3eec00.gif[/img]

[h3]New Boss Encounters[/h3]
What's an update without more boss battles to test your might? And test your might you will as you'll encounter four new boss encounters against your corrupted frenemy, The Warden...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34738184/66b83536490d0698e19b37f55886d2185dfe360a.png[/img]



We want to thank each and every one of you who's patiently waited for the release of Foregone here on Steam. We're so excited for you to finally get your hands on the game and can't wait for you to explore the world of Calagan... 

- The Foregone Team

notes.title: Foregone Releases March 1st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34738184/61e783927c8ce4aff073612816e9b136fe5331fa.gif[/img]

[h2]Release Update[/h2]

We're excited to share that Foregone is coming to Steam on March 1st, exactly one month from today!

In addition to the release on Steam, we will also be releasing an all-new update on the same day. Over the next month, we'll be going more in-depth on what the new content is that's on its way, but high level it includes:
[list]
[*] 12 new side missions
[*] 4 new boss encounters
[*] 2 new weapons
[*] A new NPC to encounter in the Outpost
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34738184/102cd85c58609c536deb2254ecf0bce5be1ed210.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Game Festival[/h2]

That's not all though. Starting this Wednesday, you'll be able to try out Foregone yourself as part of the Steam Game Festival which runs from February 3rd - 10th.

In the demo, you'll get to play through approximately the first 20 - 30 minutes of the game and take on the game's first mini-boss, Buzzbot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34738184/6babf3cae2136a41b2d6dc239c98b9e74ce6dedd.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34738184/33d361caf5e02651d60f712f50ed38fe4189663c.png[/img]

Hey there - this is Michael, Jordan, and Dino and welcome to our first dev update!

With the game officially being revealed last week at the Kinda Funny Games Showcase, we wanted to post this update to share some more info about the game and let you know when/how often we plan on posting updates here. 

The last week has been quite a whirlwind of excitement. It was great getting to see everyone’s genuine reactions to the announcement on YouTube during the Kinda Funny Games E3 showcase, and it’s been great seeing your feedback everywhere else since.  We’re taking in that feedback and actively using it to help guide us in the development of the game. 

On the topic of feedback: first and foremost, we absolutely understand the comparisons to Dead Cells, and we were prepared for this when we started development. Like everyone else, we played Dead Cells and we loved the way it felt. With Foregone, we wanted to nail the fluid feeling of Dead Cells but introduce new mechanics as part of a more linear, story-focused experience. 

[h1][b]Features:[/b][/h1]
[list][*] [b]Ultimate[/b] - A powerful ability that can be activated by the player once they’ve filled their ultimate meter [/list]
[list][*] [b]Three Unlockable Skills[/b] -  Cooldown-based skills that are recharged through weapon attacks, rewarding players who adopt a more aggressive playstyle [/list]
[list][*] [b]Skill Tree[/b] - Once the above skills are unlocked, players will gain access to a branching skill tree that can be used to create a build specific to their playstyle[/list]
[list][*] [b]Customizable Equipment[/b] - High-tiered weapons & armour (currently termed “Sealed” ) will be able to be upgraded and customized to a player’s preference through a series of increasingly difficult challenges [/list] 
[list][*] [b]Item and Character Permanence[/b] - All weapons and armour once unlocked can be accessed at any time from the hub areas known as Outposts  [/list] 
[list][*] [b]Waypoint System[/b] - Teleportation system that can be used to quickly travel between different areas[/list]

As we move closer to Early Access, we plan on doing additional dev updates and taking deeper dives into these systems. The plan right now is to do more sizable posts around once a month and having smaller quick looks every couple weeks. Hopefully, this will give a nice balance of more digestible chunks that will allow for specific feedback in helping us make the best game possible. 

We’ve also heard many people ask about console ports and support for Mac & Linux, and we 100% hear you. Our focus is currently on PC and the early access version of the game, however, we hope to bring the game to other platforms in the future. 

That’s about it for this first dev update. It’s been a crazy week but we’re so excited to have you along for the ride. Thanks for reading and check out some of the new stuff we’ve been working on below!

- Michael, Jordan, and Dino
